text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Traaainer...
P-P-P-Please help meee...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hold on, Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What on earth could be going on...?
For now, we took refuge in the Trainer's office, and once I listened carefully to the story—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Um...
They asked me to take off my glasses, so..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, according to Sweep-san, that is—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "I just can't, for the life of me, remember what her face looks like without glasses!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that weird?!
I'm positive I've seen it somewhere before!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So, it just hit me.
There must be magic cast
...on those glasses of yours.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A truly extraordinary magic
that will completely mask your true face!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And so, she asked me to take off my glasses...
She said she wanted to investigate the magic
cast upon them...
choice_data_list: You don't want to take it off and show me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a common tale to find oneself unable
to recall the bare face of someone who usually wears glasses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Once she realizes it wasn't magic,
she probably won't chase after us anymore."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!
It's not that I d-dislike it, it's more like... um...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...A long time ago, a classmate asked me to take it off, so I did to show them in the classroom."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"And then... all eyes were
suddenly on me...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I've been a little uncomfortable
taking off my glasses in crowded places...
like at the academy or around town...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roooy!
Where have you gone?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah... aha!
I bet you ran off to the Trainer's room, didn't you!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah wah...!
W-What should we do!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The options I can think of right now are—
choice_data_list: Let's outrun them at top speed!
Let's face it head-on, steady and strong!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-At top speed...!?
O-O-Okay, I understand!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: H-Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa...
Phew, looks like I managed to get aw—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roooy!
Where did you go?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Did you hate it that much?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's with you?
How am I supposed to understand if you don't say anything?!
...Fine, whatever! Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, n-no, that's not it!
I'm so sorry, Sweep-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, afterwards I saw
Zenno Rob Roy taking off her glasses
to show others on her own.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: F... From the front... are you sure...!?
choice_data_list: If we talk things out properly, I'm sure they'll understand.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...You're right... All I did was run away, without ever explaining things properly."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san is the kind of person
who will understand if you just talk to her...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'll... do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
So that's what it was!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Not really. ...Um...
I-I'm the one who should............ apologize.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sweep-san...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! As long as it's kept a secret,
I wouldn't hate it that much. So—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, at Zenno Rob Roy's suggestion,
we decided to move behind the school building where it was quieter—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...? They're just ordinary glasses, aren't they?
Oh, then why...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed the misunderstanding about the magic was successfully cleared up.
